method_limit: Literal target-ID navigation plus authored ID construction and specification dataflow is sufficient to locate the unresolved mapping dependency. No exhaustive semantic reading of every other case or all indirect tuple aliases claimed. In particular a report phrase without a target-ID bridge is not assigned to A073/A004 by guesswork.
limits: Source existence is established by tracked path and existence metadata only for the listed TSVs. No payload hash or row read was needed or performed.
The zero-card result is not missing data, semantic failure, a new experiment result or scientific closure.
No inferred phrases, glyph/form strings, case locations, equivalent propositions or meaning bindings.
Any later metadata projection must preserve the original sealed-selector guard and explicit task authorization; no automatic access is performed by this audit.
